options.text: Prerequisite check for CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security at management-group scope. Select the management group, region and infrastructure subscription; this page then verifies the required resource providers and your permissions. You cannot continue until every check passes.

options.text: Confirming Global Administrator... If this message does not change to 'confirmed' within a few seconds, your account could not read Entra ID diagnostic settings, which requires Global Administrator. Assign or activate the role (PIM), then sign out of the Azure portal, sign back in and reopen this form (role changes can take up to 10 minutes to apply).
Global Administrator confirmed (able to read Entra ID diagnostic settings).

Missing Global Administrator - you need the Global Administrator role in Entra ID to configure Entra ID log export. Assign or activate the role (PIM), then sign out of the Azure portal, sign back in and reopen this form (role changes can take up to 10 minutes to apply).
Checking your permissions on the management group... If this message does not clear, your account may have no access to it.
User Access Administrator confirmed on the management group.

Missing User Access Administrator - assign the User Access Administrator role on the management group (Owner alone is not enough), or activate it in PIM, then sign out of the Azure portal, sign back in and reopen this form (role changes can take up to 10 minutes to apply).
Owner confirmed on the management group.

Missing Owner - you need Owner on the management group. Assign Owner (or activate it in PIM), then sign out of the Azure portal, sign back in and reopen this form (role changes can take up to 10 minutes to apply).
Azure Deployment Stack Owner confirmed on the management group.

Missing Azure Deployment Stack Owner - assign the Azure Deployment Stack Owner role on the management group (Owner alone is not enough), then sign out of the Azure portal, sign back in and reopen this form (role changes can take up to 10 minutes to apply).

Checking resource provider registration in the infrastructure subscription... If this message does not clear, the check could not run - verify manually with: az provider show --namespace <namespace> --query registrationState
All resource providers enabled - every required resource provider is registered in the infrastructure subscription.

options.text: By default CrowdStrike creates a new Event Hub namespace and hubs. To reuse an existing Event Hub, enable the option below and pick the namespace, hub, and consumer group.

elements.label: Use an existing Event Hub
elements.toolTip: Reuse an existing Event Hub namespace/instance instead of creating new ones.

elements.name: ehNamespace
elements.label: Event Hub namespace
elements.toolTip: Select the existing Event Hub namespace. Activity and Entra hubs are chosen from within it.

elements.name: activityHubName
elements.label: Activity Log Event Hub
elements.toolTip: Event Hub instance that receives Azure Activity Logs.

elements.name: activityConsumerGroup
elements.label: Activity Log consumer group
elements.toolTip: Consumer group on the Activity Log Event Hub.

elements.name: entraHubName
elements.label: Entra ID Log Event Hub
elements.toolTip: Event Hub instance that receives Entra ID logs (can be the same as Activity).

elements.name: entraConsumerGroup

elements.toolTip: Consumer group on the Entra ID Log Event Hub.

options.text: Enter the Falcon US-1 IP addresses from CrowdStrike's "Allow CrowdStrike IP addresses" page (opens the US-1 docs; Falcon login required). The Event Hub firewall denies everything else, so without them real-time visibility receives no logs.

Enter the Falcon US-2 IP addresses from CrowdStrike's "Allow CrowdStrike IP addresses" page (opens the US-2 docs; Falcon login required). The Event Hub firewall denies everything else, so without them real-time visibility receives no logs.

Enter the Falcon EU-1 IP addresses from CrowdStrike's "Allow CrowdStrike IP addresses" page (opens the EU-1 docs; Falcon login required). The Event Hub firewall denies everything else, so without them real-time visibility receives no logs.
Enter the Falcon IP addresses for your Falcon cloud from CrowdStrike's "Allow CrowdStrike IP addresses" documentation page (Falcon login required). The Event Hub firewall denies everything else.
